google.label: Google Sign-In
google.description: Allow users to sign in with their Google account
google.step1: Buɗe Google Cloud Console sannan ka zaɓi aiki mai gudana, ko ka ƙirƙiri sabo don wannan shago.
google.step2: A ƙarƙashin APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen, cika sunan app, imel ɗin tallafi da amintaccen yanki, sannan ka wallafa app ɗin. Muddin yana cikin Testing, masu amfani na gwaji da ka lissafa kaɗai za su iya shiga.
google.step3: Je Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID sannan ka zaɓi Web application a matsayin nau'i.
google.step4: A ƙarƙashin Authorized JavaScript origins, ƙara:
google.step5: A ƙarƙashin Authorized redirect URIs, ƙara:
google.step6: Kwafi Client ID da Client secret zuwa filayen da ke sama, ka adana, sannan ka danna Tabbatar da bayanai. Sabbin abokan ciniki na Google na iya ɗaukar mintuna kaɗan kafin su fara aiki.

facebook.label: Facebook Sign-In
facebook.description: Allow users to sign in with their Facebook account
facebook.step1: Buɗe Meta for Developers → My Apps → Create app, sannan ka zaɓi amfani “Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login”.
facebook.step2: Ƙara samfurin Facebook Login a cikin app ɗin, sannan ka buɗe Facebook Login → Settings.
facebook.step3: Kunna Client OAuth login da Web OAuth login, sannan ka ƙara wannan a ƙarƙashin Valid OAuth Redirect URIs:
facebook.step4: A cikin App settings → Basic, sanya Site URL zuwa
facebook.step4c: a ƙarƙashin App domains. Meta na kuma buƙatar URL ɗin Manufar Sirri kafin app ɗin ya fara aiki a bainar jama'a.
facebook.step5: Kwafi App ID da App Secret zuwa filayen da ke sama, ka adana, sannan ka danna Tabbatar da bayanai.
facebook.step6: Canza app ɗin daga Development zuwa Live. Kafin haka, mutane masu matsayi a cikin app ɗin kaɗai za su iya shiga da Facebook.

localRetired.title: Local storage has been retired
localRetired.body: Fayilolin da ke kan wannan sabar suna ci gaba da aiki, amma sabbin ɗorawa suna buƙatar ɗaya daga cikin masu bada sabis da ke ƙasa. Zaɓi ɗaya, shigar da bayanansa, sannan buɗe “Matsar da fayilolin da kake da su” — a can akwai umarnin da kuma madadin da za a ɗauka kafin turawa na gaba.

cloudflare_r2.bucket: A cikin dashboard ɗin Cloudflare buɗe R2 → Create bucket. Sunansa yana shiga cikin Sunan bucket a sama.
cloudflare_r2.token: R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens → Create API token, izini Object Read & Write, na wannan bucket kaɗai. Kwafa sassan biyu zuwa Access Key ID da Secret Access Key a sama — ana nuna sirrin sau ɗaya kawai.
cloudflare_r2.account: Kwafa Account ID mai haruffa 32 daga gefen shafin R2 zuwa filin R2 Account ID.
cloudflare_r2.public: Bucket → Settings → Public access: kunna subdomain ɗin r2.dev ko haɗa domain naka, sannan liƙa wannan adireshin cikin Public URL.
cloudflare_r2.test: Danna Gwada haɗi, sannan ka adana. Gwajin yana ɗora fayil ɗin gwaji ya sake karanta shi ta hanyar public URL, don haka zai gaza idan an tsallake matakin da ya gabata.
cloudflare_r2.caution: Ba tare da Public URL ba, kowace hoton kaya zai dawo da 403 a mai bincike ko da bayanan shiga sun yi daidai — fayilolin suna zuwa daga endpoint ɗin R2 na sirri, wanda ba a taɓa karanta shi ba tare da izini ba. Domain naka ya fi r2.dev: sai CDN ɗin Cloudflare ya amsa buƙatun da aka ajiye ba tare da caji bucket ba.

s3.bucket: Ƙirƙiri bucket a console ɗin S3 kuma ka lura da yankinsa — dole ya yi daidai da yankin da aka zaɓa a sama.
s3.iam: IAM → ƙirƙiri mai amfani da damar shiga ta shirye-shirye da manufa da ke ba da waɗannan ayyuka a kan wannan bucket:
s3.public: Ba da izinin karatun jama'a ta manufar bucket, ko sanya CloudFront a gaba, sannan liƙa adireshin da aka samu cikin Public URL.
s3.test: Liƙa maɓallan biyu a sama, danna Gwada haɗi, sannan ka adana.
s3.caution: Sabbin bucket suna zuwa da Block all public access a kunne. Ka bar shi a kunne kawai idan kana bayarwa ta CloudFront — in ba haka ba kowace hoto a shago zai dawo da 403.

minio.run: Gudanar da MinIO kusa da manhajar — Coolify da Dokploy duk suna da samfurin danna sau ɗaya. Haɗa volume a /data, in ba haka ba turawa na gaba zai ɗauke duk fayilolin da aka ɗora.
minio.keys: Buɗe console ɗin MinIO (tashar 9001 ta asali), ƙirƙiri bucket, sannan Access Keys → Create access key.
minio.public: Bar masu bincike su karanta bucket:
minio.fields: Endpoint URL shine adireshin API (tashar 9000), ba console ba. Yankin zai iya zama us-east-1 — MinIO baya kula da shi. Public URL shine inda masu bincike ke isa bucket.
minio.test: Danna Gwada haɗi, sannan ka adana.
minio.caution: Bayar da MinIO ta HTTPS a kan subdomain nasa. Masu bincike suna toshe abun ciki gauraye, don haka endpoint ɗin http:// yana lalata kowace hoto a shagon HTTPS.

digitalocean.space: Spaces Object Storage → Create a Space. Cibiyar bayanan da ka zaɓa ita ce endpoint (nyc3, fra1, sgp1…), don haka zaɓi wacce ke kusa da abokan cinikinka kuma zaɓi yanki ɗaya a sama.
digitalocean.keys: API → Spaces Keys → Generate New Key, sannan kwafa sassan biyu zuwa Access Key ID da Secret Access Key.
digitalocean.public: Space → Settings → saita File Listing zuwa jama'a, ko kunna CDN.
digitalocean.test: Bar Public URL fanko don bayarwa kai tsaye daga Space, ko liƙa endpoint ɗin CDN (…cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com) don bayarwa daga gefe. Sannan gwada haɗin ka adana.
digitalocean.caution: Sunan Space shine Sunan bucket a sama, kuma ba za a iya matsar da Space zuwa wata cibiyar bayanai daga baya ba — ana kayyade yankinsa lokacin ƙirƙira.

migration.title: Matsar da fayilolin da kake da su
migration.intro: Zaɓar mai bada sabis yana canza inda sabbin ɗorawa za su tafi kawai. Duk abin da aka ɗora a baya yana nan inda yake kuma yana ci gaba da aiki har sai ka matsar da shi.
migration.step1: Saita mai bada sabis a sama sannan danna Gwada haɗi — ƙaura tana ɗorawa zuwa abin da aka adana a nan.
migration.step2: Matsar da bayanan shiga da aka adana zuwa tsarin kowane mai bada sabis. Yana da aminci a kowace siga, kuma baya yin komai bayan an gudanar sau ɗaya.
migration.step3: Ɗora fayilolin cikin gida kuma sake rubuta URL ɗinsu a duk faɗin bayanan. Gwajin bushe yana lissafa kowane fayil kuma baya rubuta komai.
migration.step4: Duba shagon da Media Library. Ba a taɓa share komai daga faifai ba, don haka ka cire kwafin cikin gida da kanka bayan hotunan sun fito.
migration.backup: Kafin turawa na gaba: idan hanyar sabuntawarka tana maye gurbin babban fayil ɗin manhajar — ɗorawa ta cPanel, rubutu da zip, kwantena ba tare da volume ba — fara kwafa fayilolin media daga sabar. Maye gurbin babban fayil yana share su.
migration.note: Fayil ɗin da ya kasa ɗorawa yana riƙe da URL ɗinsa na cikin gida, don haka gudu mara cika yana barin shago mai aiki maimakon rabin karye. Sake gudanarwa yana da aminci.
